metadata.description: 6-Max Cash, 100bb. SB opens to 3bb, Hero is in the BB. 3-bet to 12bb, call 2bb more, or fold.

source.detail: Hand-authored from standard 6-max 100bb preflop theory. NOT solver output - these are reasonable reference ranges, not an equilibrium. Replace with solver exports when available.

spec.RAISE: 88+, ATs+, ATo+, KQs, KJs, KTs, QJs, QTs, JTs, KQo, A9s-A2s, K9s-K6s, Q9s, J9s, T8s, 97s, 86s, 75s, 65s, 54s

explanations.RAISE: Blind versus blind, heads-up, against the widest range anyone opens. We 3-bet a lot: SB is out of position for the rest of the hand and has to fold or play a big pot without the initiative.
explanations.CALL: We only need 2bb more to see a flop heads-up in position. Almost any hand with a suit, a connection or a high card continues.
explanations.FOLD: A very small fold range - the worst offsuit hands only. Against an SB opening this wide, folding is the mistake.
